name: project-mcp
description: An MCP server skeleton in TypeScript, speaking MCP 2026-07-28 on the official SDK

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --import tsx --test "src/**/*.test.ts" "test/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.inspect: npm run build --silent && npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2.7.0 --web node dist/main.js --protocol-era modern
scripts.inspect:cli: npm run build --silent && npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2.7.0 --cli node dist/main.js --protocol-era modern
